title: EmailComparator::property is String — enum with Other(String) would make invalid sorts detectable
description: RFC 8621 §4.4.2 defines a closed set of valid property names for Email/query comparators: receivedAt, size, from, to, subject, sentAt, hasKeyword, allInThreadHaveKeyword, someInThreadHaveKeyword. The field is String, making it impossible to detect 'keyword is required when property is hasKeyword/allInThreadHaveKeyword/someInThreadHaveKeyword' at the type level. An enum ComparatorProperty { ReceivedAt, Size, ..., HasKeyword, AllInThreadHaveKeyword, SomeInThreadHaveKeyword, Other(String) } with the keyword-required variants calling out in doc comments would make this constraint visible to callers without adding runtime overhead. The relationship between property and keyword is currently documented in prose only; misspelling 'hasKeyword' as 'hasKeywords' silently produces a server error.
notes: API-breaking change: changes EmailComparator::property from String to enum ComparatorProperty. Deferred to next semver bump (0.2.0).
